user.title: Connect to the Android device
user.description: The dedicated Android device must be on the same network with ADB over TCP enabled (adb tcpip 5555).

error.cannot_connect: TCP connection failed. Check the IP address and that 'adb tcpip 5555' has been run since the last device reboot.
error.auth_rejected: The device rejected the connection. Accept the USB debugging authorization dialog on the device screen and try again.
error.invalid_device: The device answered, but not like the expected Android device. Check that the address points at the dedicated phone.

abort.already_configured: This Android device is already configured.

data.dump_on_failure: Save a UI dump on failure
data.widget_refresh_enabled: Tap the widget refresh control before each poll (may query the vehicle)
